SYMPTOM: `back` command in Maestro flow on iOS doesn't pop the NavigationStack — it appears to scroll the view or do nothing.
CAUSE: Maestro's `back` maps to Android's back button behavior, not iOS navigation. iOS NavigationStack back requires a swipe from the left edge.
FIX: Use `swipe: { direction: LEFT, startX: 0, startY: 50% }` or tap the back button text directly (e.g., `tapOn: '< Techniques'`). Coordinate tap on back chevron at ~8%,7% is unreliable — hit the text label instead.
PREVENT: Never use bare `back` for iOS navigation stack pops in Maestro flows.
